lessons.title: Introducing Ratios and Ratio Language
mathematicalTaskRequirements: Choose two or three categories of tangible objects and count them
Express multiple ratio sentences with category order named
Build a student-defined collection diagram/table and partner review
Shade 24-unit rectangle in a 2:1 ratio, design another differently sized shape in same ratio
lessons.firstPartyCandidateExample: 6:3:3 category model; 24 area=16+8 and 18 area=12+6 despite equal ratios
lessons.humanReviewBoundary: student categories, table and original color-shaded shape

lessons.title: Representing Ratios with Diagrams
sourceActivities: 2.1 Number Talk: Dividing by 4 and Multiplying by 1/4
mathematicalTaskRequirements: Partner exchange of colored cube ratios and sentences
Compare 2 cups white paint to 6 tablespoons blue paint with two named units
Draw 8 cups flour : 2 pints water, retaining unlike units
Match multi-ingredient visual recipes to correct ordered ratios; discuss disagreements
lessons.firstPartyCandidateExample: 4:2:1 three-ingredient graphic symbols (cup, tablespoon, teaspoon), warm-up 24/4=6
lessons.humanReviewBoundary: multi-quantity ratio diagram and partner corrections

lessons.title: Recipes
sourceActivities: 3.4 Cool-down - A Smaller Batch of Bird Food
mathematicalTaskRequirements: Scale polygon flower pattern from one to multiple copies
Discuss concentrated versus dilute drink mixes with matching ordered quantities
Compare sodium concentration using common sodium-mass per drink-volume units
Scale cookie ratio 5 cups flour to 2 teaspoons vanilla across 2, 3, 5 batches
lessons.humanReviewBoundary: source diagrams, mixture taste assumptions and appropriate units
